10 استعذب المَآءَ He reckoned, or esteemed, the water sweet. (O, Msb, TA.) ―
-b2- And He sought sweet water: you say, استعذب لِأَهْلِهِ he sought sweet water for his family. (TA.) ―
-b3- And He drank the water sweet. (TA.) ―
-b4- And He drew sweet water. (S, O, K. *) One says, يُسْتَعْذَبُ لِفُلَانٍ مِنْ بِئْرِ كَذَا i. e. [Sweet water] is drawn for such a one from such a well. (S, O.) ―
-b5- And استعذب لَهُ المَآءَ He brought to him sweet water. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 4.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
